primitives.name: Text Classification Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Bengali text classification is a Significant task in natural language processing (NLP), where text is categorized into predefined labels.
primitives.assumptions: Input text T is encoded via transformer embeddings; categories C are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T lacks semantic structure or C is ill-defined.

layer2.mapping: LLM latent space projection maps T → embedding space, then K maps to discrete category distribution P(C|T).
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy metric on held-out test set

primitives.name: LLM Inference Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: Three instruction-tuned LLMs—LLaMA 3.1 8B Instruct, LLaMA 3.2 3B Instruct, and Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct—were evaluated for this task under the same classification framework.
primitives.assumptions: Models are instruction-tuned and operate within zero-shot or few-shot paradigms; X is tokenized and embedded.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When L lacks sufficient training on Bengali domain or X contains out-of-vocabulary tokens.

layer2.mapping: Each L maps input X to Y through attention-weighted context aggregation; final softmax yields P(Y|X).
layer2.telemetry: Perplexity and cross-entropy loss on validation set

primitives.name: Accuracy Benchmark
primitives.verbatim_quote: Among the evaluated models, Qwen 2.5 achieved the highest classification accuracy of 72%, showing particular strength in the "Sports" category.
primitives.assumptions: A is computed over independent test samples; S is a subset of all categories C.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A drops below threshold due to class imbalance or misalignment between M and S.

layer2.mapping: A = Σᵢ I(yᵢ = ŷᵢ)/n, where yᵢ is true label, ŷᵢ is predicted, and n total samples.
layer2.telemetry: F1-score per class and macro-average F1
